6117eb7ac0.q: What problem does the Bubéd nursing pad solve that existing nursing pads on the market lack?
6117eb7ac0.a: Existing nursing pads have not evolved since they were invented and are simply cotton circles designed to absorb leaky milk with no additional protection for wounds and fissures that develop during breastfeeding. The Bubéd nursing pad differentiates itself with a silicone center that won't stick to healing wounds and skin while still allowing ointment to absorb into the skin rather than the pad, combined with cotton and SAP (super absorbent polymer) on top to maintain milk absorption capabilities.
